items.description: Nutrition for Noobs is a podcast hosted by Kevin Harries and Michelle Pierce-Hamilton offering accessible, science-based discussions about food, nutrition and healthy living (with a strong plant-based / whole-food leaning)
Home page of the Nutrition for Noobs podcast
Episode archive listing all past Nutrition for Noobs episodes
Start Here page with episodes curated by broad topic for newcomers
About page introducing the two co-hosts
Contact page for listener questions, sponsorship enquiries, guest requests and email sign-up
Individual numbered podcast episode pages (about 72 episodes) on nutrition topics such as protein, gut health, fibre, plant-based diets, food additives, longevity, and recipes
Episodes featuring guest experts (e.g., Dr. Zahra Kassam on cancer, Dr. Matthew Nagra on U.S. dietary guidelines, Dr. Deborah Keil on PFAS, Dr. Marianne Trevorrow on menopause)
Recipe episodes ("Recipes for Noobs") with plant-based recipes such as vegan Caesar dressing, gazpacho, oil-free chocolate cake and bang bang cauliflower
Episode page URLs follow the pattern /<episode number>-<slug>.html; there is a special half-numbered episode 49.5 celebrating 50 episodes (bloopers/outtakes)
The show is Canadian-oriented, with episodes covering Canada's 2019 Food Guide and Canada's alcohol guidelines
